en: Colorized historic postcard view of a large neoclassical building with a central domed tower and two long wings with red roofs, labeled as a museum. The building faces an expansive open square or parade ground where small figures of people stroll. The sky is blue with scattered clouds, and low hills and trees are visible in the distance. The words "Zwickau." and "Museum." appear at the top.
